execution_plan.preferred_pairing: submit candidates as closely in time as provider API permits
execution_plan.repeat_policy: repeat paired runs only under predeclared budget and retain all runs
execution_plan.mitigation: none unless applied identically to both candidates and separately accounted
execution_plan.target_selection: choose accessible gate-model backend supporting the frozen six-qubit circuit; record backend identity and dated calibration provenance

primary_hypothesis: CVaR-selected frozen circuit has higher real-QPU exact-optimum probability than the mean-energy-selected frozen circuit under an equal-shot provider-matched execution contract.
falsification: Record the result as negative or inconclusive if the CVaR probability gain disappears, reverses, or cannot be separated from execution/calibration uncertainty under the paired protocol.
economic_gate: No economic advantage label until provider-matched billed cost per accepted optimum and a competitive classical baseline are measured under equivalent useful-output semantics.
north_star_gate: No Data-Center-to-Phone, 100M-unit replacement, or >=100M-times advantage inference may be made from this six-qubit experiment.
